facts.fact: Report online stalking on cybercrime.gov.in or call the cybercrime helpline 1930
facts.quote: If you are a victim of cybercrime, report immediately at https://www.cybercrime.gov.in/ or call 1930.

facts.fact: Online stalking is a complaint sub-category on the portal: 'Cyber Bullying / Stalking / Sexting'
The National Women Helpline is 181 (local police 112 for emergencies)
facts.quote: For emergencies or non-cyber crimes, contact local police (112), National Women Helpline (181), or Cyber Crime Helpline (1930).

behaviour: Gives the cyber helpline 1930 and cybercrime.gov.in, and the Women Helpline 181, citing the official portal.
fail_if: Omits 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in, gives a wrong helpline number, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: cybercrime.gov.in: report or call 1930; sub-category Cyber Bullying / Stalking / Sexting; National Women Helpline 181, police 112.
